dialogues.speaker: Hinterman
dialogues.text: Welcome to Poisson, a little place for us fishermen.

dialogues.speaker: Hinterman
dialogues.text: The sights here aren't as grand as you'll see in the city, but everyone here lives a leisurely life.

dialogues.speaker: Hinterman
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I should probably mention that the terrain here can be quite slippery, so if you're here to travel, do watch your step.
